# Kérberos, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does
Archetypes are not metaphors; they are job descriptions written early. **Kérberos**'s was unusually clear.

Kérberos' myths are the myths of every threshold that must not be crossed — and of the handful of heroes who crossed his anyway.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Kérberos
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Underworld Guardian
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Technology & Innovation · Commerce & Governance · Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Cybersecurity & Digital Protection
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 54 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Born of Typhon and Echidna.** Hesiod sets him in the monstrous brood of Typhon and Echidna (Theogony 306-312): Orthrus the hound of Geryon, then "Cerberus the flesh-eater, the brazen-voiced hound of Hades, fifty-headed, shameless and strong," and after him the Lernaean Hydra and the Chimaira.  The family is the underworld's kennel and armory in one: wherever the myths need an impossible guardian, one of Echidna's children is already on duty. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**The Porter of the Dead.** Later in the same poem (Theogony 767-773) Hesiod gives the hound his job description: he waits before the houses of Hades and dread Persephone, and on those who come in he fawns with his tail and both ears — but he lets none go back out; he watches, and devours whomsoever he catches passing the gates.  It is the earliest full portrait of the boundary's one-way logic: courtesy inward, annihilation outward. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Cybersecurity & Digital Protection

*Threat defense, authentication, and digital trust. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*The three-headed watchdog at the gate; the perimeter that never sleeps.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Defense, Military & Security

*Defense contracting, security services, and strategic studies. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The warden of the dead; border security with three heads and one rule — none leave.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Kérberos performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Pet Care & Animal Industries

*Pet products, veterinary care, and animal brands. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*The most famous hound in myth; the ancestor of every guard dog.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Kérberos' myths are the myths of every threshold that must not be crossed — and of the handful of heroes who crossed his anyway. The age changed. The work did not.
